title: match_mode
description: The `match_mode` content kind (megaplan 1.7 and task 8-M1): one mode a Cyberpunk-linked player can pick at the Match Terminal (team deathmatch, free for all, Gang Wars, last team standing). One mode per file; a datapack adds a mode or replaces one with the same id. `teams` and `team_size` bound how many teams a match has and how many players each holds (free for all is many teams of one). `time_limit_s` is the default time limit (the creator may shorten it), `score_limit` the score that ends the match early. `scoring` is the points: `kill` for a player kill (the revive of a downed teammate is never a kill), `capture` for every second a team holds a capture point it owns. `respawn_s` is the wait before a defeated player returns to the team's spawn point (0: no return, the player is out until the match ends). `friendly_fire` is whether teammates hurt each other (the PvP toggle rule of 8-M1 still applies first); `pvp` is true when the mode switches the PvP toggle ON for its players for the length of the match. `zone` bounds the match area picked on the Holo-Table (the radius in blocks). `capture_points` (absent: none) is how many points the area holds, their `radius`, and the `seconds` a lone team standing in one needs to take it. `districts` is true when the area is split into districts that each team owns a spawn point in (Gang Wars). `reputation` is true when the match result changes how the game's factions treat the winners' hosts (the `attitude` message, Phase 0 (e); without the write it does nothing). `heat_scale` scales how much of the match's chaos feeds the server Heat meter (0: none). `roles` are the roles a player can take: teammate, hacker (the Van), spectator and overlord. `team_palette` is the colours and names teams take in order; an optional `faction` is the game attitude group the team stands in for (used with `reputation`). Text is original.
